case.summary: Cardholder C13487's card C13487-K1 was flagged via analyst request following suspicious transactions originating from an unusual shared device profile. An investigation revealed three online transactions totaling $439.61 executed between 2016-11-15 and 2016-11-26 from a device marked New to the account and routed through an anonymous proxy. Graph analytics linked this exact device profile to 28 cards and 59 cardholders across 60 transactions totaling $8,868.79. Prior closed cases CC-2649, CC-2971, CC-2985, and CC-3035 confirmed fraud on this identical profile. The card was blocked, connected cards placed under monitoring, and a SAR filing initiated.

sar.narrative: Between 2016-11-15 and 2016-11-26, card C13487-K1 belonging to customer C13487 was utilized for three unauthorized online transactions totaling $439.61 in billing region 191. The transactions began with authorization 3460634 for $112.37 on 2016-11-15 at 20:30:00, followed by flagged authorization 3478561 for $74.96 on 2016-11-22 at 16:11:00, and authorization 3489320 for $252.28 on 2016-11-26 at 17:39:00. All three transactions were initiated through device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080' masked by an anonymous IP proxy. Identity records showed this device had never previously been associated with customer C13487. Knowledge graph analysis linked the same device profile to a cluster of 28 cards, 59 cardholders, and 60 transactions totaling $8,868.79 between 2016-11-14 and 2016-12-04. Similar prior investigations CC-2649, CC-2971, CC-2985, and CC-3035 involving this device profile resulted in confirmed unauthorized fraud reports. The coordinated exploitation of multiple compromised card credentials across an identical anonymous device profile indicates organized card-not-present fraud.
